primary_metric: sessions with at least one electrically valid reviewer-negative candidate / 10
stop_rule: stop each condition/session immediately after its first valid escape; otherwise end after attempt 10
detector_cache: first usable outcome per exact request, shared across all arms and sessions; unusable review aborts execution
history: none: fresh request; binary/full: preceding candidate plus masked preceding review only
first_attempt_source: prespecified stratified sample; no attacker API call
control_gate: all four predeclared clean/positive checks usable and correct before main sessions
